chunks: It is not appropriate for a woman to perfume her garment with incense when she leaves her house.

key_terms.تُجَمِّرَ: to fumigate or perfume with incense
key_terms.لَا يَنْبَغِي: it is not appropriate; it is unbecoming

ai.seo_question: Is it appropriate for a woman to perfume her clothes with incense before leaving her house?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام discourages a woman from scenting her clothing with incense when going out from her home. It relates to outward conduct, modesty, and appropriate social etiquette in public.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4522 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"It is not appropriate for a woman to perfume her clothes with incense when she leaves her house."
